subject: Naya Power White Paper Trifecta + MAXESS Human-Test Readiness

naya.summary: The three Naya Power white papers are now an official canonical WHY→WHAT→HOW knowledge trifecta and should be offered as the deep-reference set when people ask what Naya Power is. White-paper distribution is a future awareness strategy using owned canonical publication first, then high-signal technology platforms, professional networks, communities, and news/press channels. MAXESS remains blocked from human testing until browser execution is machine-proven end-to-end.

MAXESS human testing must be earned by executable evidence, not optimism.
